svg.title: Z Route complete Base leveling route, levels 1 through 30
svg.desc: A three-column guide listing Base construction time, combined Base and prerequisite resources, and per-building prerequisite workloads for multi-slot scheduling at every Base level.
svg.text: Z ROUTE / COMPLETE BASE LEVELING GUIDE
Base time, combined resource requirements, and independently schedulable prerequisite building work
Elapsed time depends on construction slots and scheduling
BAND TOTAL · BASE TIME + ALL RESOURCES
BAND TOTAL · BASE TIME + ALL RESOURCES
BAND TOTAL · BASE TIME + ALL RESOURCES
Each row is incremental from the prior Base level. Total Resources includes that Base upgrade and every recursively required building upgrade; sum rows for any cumulative target.
Building Work shows each prerequisite building’s level range and its own sequential time. Different buildings may run in parallel when additional construction slots are available.
Base Time excludes prerequisite time. Actual elapsed time depends on slot count, scheduling, speed bonuses, alliance help, events, and server overrides. F Food · M Metal · O Oil.
